content: {"action":"write_off","reasoning":"The denial is for missing required prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; a medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted. Resubmission cannot cure the authorization defect, and the invalid diagnosis pairing cannot be changed without supported coding documentation. Because CO-197 is a provider-side authorization failure, billing the patient would be improper, so the balance should be written off."}
